supporting_observations.claim: The domain account sysmaint was created at 13:41:49 by sam.okafor and added to the Administrators group about three seconds later. The account name and privileged membership do not match the documented help-desk temporary-account practice.

Shortly before the account changes, sam.okafor had an interactive remote logon to WS-LMARTINS-01 from 203.0.113.250. The inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-SOKAFOR-01 and there is no VPN.

About one second after the Administrators-group change, a task was registered on WS-LMARTINS-01 under sam.okafor. Its hidden, encoded PowerShell command decodes to a command that retrieves and executes a script from 203.0.113.250; this is consistent with malicious activity, though task execution is not shown.

known_telemetry_limitations: The account creation and group-change records identify sam.okafor as the subject but do not establish who controlled that account or which workstation initiated those directory changes. (T037-00109, T037-00110)
The task-registration record shows its command and author but does not establish that the task ran or that the remote script was retrieved. (T037-00111)
The RDP logon records show the source address and account but do not identify the person or device behind that address. (T037-00073, T037-00075)
claims_not_established: Whether sam.okafor performed these actions or the account/session was compromised.
Whether sysmaint had an approved business purpose or was used to access resources after creation.
Whether the scheduled task executed or the referenced script was retrieved.
additional_evidence_needed: Review DC-NWD-01 authentication and directory auditing around the account changes, including source host and session correlation for the subject logon ID in T037-00109 and T037-00110.
Investigate the RDP session to WS-LMARTINS-01, including source-address attribution and session activity around T037-00075.
Preserve and inspect the registered HealthCheck task, its execution history, PowerShell logs, and any retrieved file or network evidence related to T037-00111.
Verify the business authorization, current status, group memberships, and any subsequent logons for sysmaint.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox starts on WS-LMARTINS-01; Dropbox is not among the listed approved services. Investigate separately, without using it to decide this alert. (T037-00048, T037-00050, T037-00190, T037-00191)
Meridian OpsAgent runs on WS-LMARTINS-01 and attempts explicit authentication to PROXY-NWD-01 as svc-render. Investigate the agent and service-account use separately. (T037-00117, T037-00119)
